body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces the FigureAsset VLM Authorization Harness along with its corresponding unit tests and several generated artifact files representing a non-authorized shard run. The code review feedback focuses on enhancing the robustness of the harness to ensure it fails closed on malformed inputs. Key recommendations include recording diagnostics for parsing errors in optional files instead of silently ignoring them, validating the shape of the input packet, rows, and checkpoint arrays to prevent runtime TypeErrors, adding an explicit validator check for input diagnostics, and implementing a unit test to verify these fail-closed behaviors.
